errors.text_span: zur Wichtigkeit verschiedener Unterstützungsformen für junge Menschen bei Unternehmensgründungen
errors.evidence: This part of the description interprets the chart's purpose from external context (the paper title) rather than describing the visual content of the figure itself. The figure's title is 'alle Befragten mit Antwort ja (in %)' (all respondents with answer yes (in %)).

errors.text_span: wobei die Werte in ganzen und Dezimalzahlen angegeben sind
errors.evidence: This phrase is ambiguous as it is unclear whether it refers to the axis tick labels (which are integers) or the data labels for the bars (which are decimal numbers).

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge nach Prozentwert angeordnet
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars are arranged in descending order of value. The bars are not sorted; for example, 'Zutrauen' (25.40%) has a higher value than 'Unsicherheit' (24.56%) but is listed below it, and 'Stress' (17.46%) is listed above 'Wissen' (20.31%).
